note: Accepted vulnerability advisories for scripts/sbom/scan-dependencies.mjs (the local Dependabot-equivalent). Each entry needs a real `reason`; `expires` (YYYY-MM-DD) forces re-review — past expiry the finding re-surfaces and the gate can fail again. This is the local mirror of Dependabot/CodeQL dismiss-with-justification. See docs/architecture/dependency-reduction-routine.md.

accepted.reason: Trusted-pattern-only mobile build tooling (BI-0AE77798). The platform lockfile contains no braces. In apps/mobile/pnpm-lock.yaml the only direct consumers are micromatch@4.0.8 and chokidar@3.6.0, reached through Metro file-map and Tailwind/fast-glob build-time file discovery. apps/mobile/tailwind.config.ts supplies three repository-controlled globs; metro.config.js uses Expo defaults and a fixed ./global.css NativeWind input. No mobile app/src/dynamic source imports braces, micromatch, chokidar or fast-glob. The advisory requires an attacker-controlled deeply nested brace PATTERN; matching a filename against these fixed patterns does not grant pattern control. No patched release is listed by the GitHub advisory as of 2026-10-03. Re-evaluate on a patch release, a Metro/Tailwind upgrade, or before accepting external glob patterns or exposing the development server to untrusted callers.

Trusted-input-only. js-yaml 3.14.2 is a transitive dep of gray-matter, used for build-time frontmatter parsing of our own repo-controlled .md files — never attacker-supplied YAML, so the quadratic-complexity DoS is not reachable. The fix is in js-yaml 4.x, a breaking major gray-matter does not support (consistent with the prior tolerable_risk dismissal, Dependabot #74). Re-evaluate if gray-matter adopts js-yaml 4 or a 3.x patch ships.

Not reachable. node-forge 1.4.0 enters only apps/mobile/pnpm-lock.yaml, as a dependency of @expo/cli and @expo/code-signing-certificates (Expo's command-line build tooling); it is not bundled into the shipped app and never runs on a server. The flaw is RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature-verification forgery with low-exponent keys, used by Expo only for expo-updates code signing, which DPF's mobile app does not use (no expo-updates dependency and no codeSigning config in app.json, eas.json or package.json, checked 2026-10-02). No fixed version exists (affected through 1.4.0). Re-evaluate when node-forge publishes a fix, when Expo drops or patches it, or before enabling expo-updates code signing.

Not reachable from a shipped runtime. braces 3.0.3 is only in apps/mobile/pnpm-lock.yaml. tailwindcss 3.4.19 (a mobile devDependency) pulls it through chokidar and micromatch, and Metro's Node bundler pulls it through metro-file-map and micromatch. The mobile app source does not import braces, micromatch, or chokidar. The flaw is a stack overflow when a caller supplies a deeply nested brace pattern. Those callers expand this repo's own Tailwind and Metro globs, not request input. No patched npm release exists (3.0.3 is the latest; micromatch/braces#72 is unreleased). Re-evaluate when braces publishes a depth guard, or when Expo or Tailwind stop depending on 3.0.3. Checked 2026-10-03.
